scenarios.name: Product and UI parity
scenarios.start_state: owner with an active assigned draft
assertions: assigned start, save, resume, submit, and review preserve accepted UI behavior

scenarios.name: Assignment and providers
scenarios.start_state: respondent and delegate with active and invalid contexts
assertions: only an exact active assignment starts a Response
typed FormVersion snapshot renders without provider storage access

scenarios.name: Scoped review
scenarios.start_state: owner, delegate, scoped manager, and disjoint outsider
assertions: owner, delegate, and scoped manager visibility is exact
known and random forbidden identities are indistinguishable

scenarios.name: Dataset and Workflow consumers
scenarios.cleanup: restore consumer cursors and reference materialization

scenarios.name: Replay, compatibility, and outage
scenarios.start_state: administrator with independently addressable provider bindings
assertions: binding faults retain last-good state and recover

scenarios.name: Configuration and diagnostics
scenarios.start_state: administrator and operator on a healthy Response owner
assertions: generic Module Management validates and applies Response configuration

scenarios.name: Fresh materialization and no-op
assertions: from-empty owner order returns signed read-back
unchanged apply is a semantic no-op

scenarios.name: Core subtraction and isolation
assertions: Core has no Response schema, routes, adapters, or seed

scenarios.name: Failure recovery
scenarios.start_state: empty topology with one bounded fault
assertions: exact teardown permits a clean successor from-empty apply

scenarios.name: Upgrade and rollback
assertions: Response-only upgrade, rollback, and restore preserve state and unrelated owners

scenarios.name: Roadmap exit
scenarios.start_state: tester with assigned work and healthy downstream owners
assertions: consume submitted output through Dataset, Component, and Dashboard without shared database access
